purpose: A speed-dial: one floating trigger that opens up to five related actions. Use it when several floating actions share one entry point, such as create a photo, a note or a share.

notFor.case: More than five actions, or actions that need a scrolling list.
A row of related actions that sit in the layout, not floating.

Open=false.visual: The trigger FABButton with its plus icon; it keeps its own fill in both states.

Open=true.visual: The trigger icon swaps to an X; the items appear as a labelled vertical stack, or as icon-only FABs on an arc (fan-center, fan-left, fan-right).

a11y.role: group, with an aria-label; the trigger is a native <button> with aria-expanded
a11y.keyboard: Tab reaches the trigger; Enter or Space toggles it. Items are native buttons reached by Tab.
notes: The trigger's accessible name defaults to its Label ("Create"), which is never shown.
Fan items are icon-only, so each item's label becomes its aria-label.
Disabled turns off the trigger and every item.

openQuestions: Reduced motion: the opening uses use-stagger-in / use-stagger-out (design plan), but the contract declares no motion. Should items appear at once with reduced motion?
Closing: does Escape or a click outside close the group, and does focus return to the trigger? Nothing in the contract says.
Arrow keys: should arrow keys move between items, or is Tab the only way?
